evidence.accessCatalog: The Henrys Fork Angler Access catalog lists McCrea Bridge Campground at 44.46132608,-111.40061335, with Caribou-Targhee National Forest ownership, paved boat ramp, and parking.
evidence.agencyContext: Recreation.gov confirms the McCrea Bridge campground and ramp, and warns that Island Park Reservoir drawdown can make the ramp inaccessible by August.
evidence.coordinateFit: The stored coordinate matches the published access point to sub-meter precision. The 352-foot connected-network offset and 194-foot mapped-water distance reflect the campground/ramp facility on the reservoir backwater corridor, not a wrong take-out.
